title: Text and writing rules
slide_intent: Teach a writer to choose the name that identifies a museum site unambiguously, even when a park or neighborhood has a similar name.
strategic_value: Consistent site names can make each destination recognizable across the Sheffield Museums family.
demonstration: Two columns cover the six venues, with sample sentences for the Graves and Millennium galleries. A yellow Weston Park Museum spread demonstrates a complete venue name in use.
practical_value: Keep Museum in Kelham Island Museum and Weston Park Museum and retain Workshop in Shepherd Wheel Workshop. Follow the article guidance when referring to the galleries in prose.

content_islands.spec: Divide the six sites across two columns. Set the site names as subheads and place the examples or shortening rules directly beneath them.
